The MIT notice travels beside it as COPYING-uigradients.txt and is packed
into the GIF too, so a copy of this app that someone was handed still
carries the notice it is required to carry.

The original Vue site cannot ride in (GifOS drops type=module). This
directory is the port: the same colour list, browse and copy, private
favourites, and a shared pick. Nothing is fetched at run time.
